change_log.original: Published comparisons on maths tasks (Uesato et al., 2022; Lightman et al., 2023) report advantages for process supervision in their settings; results depend on domain and labelling method and should not be assumed to transfer.
change_log.corrected: Published comparisons on maths tasks differ in what they find: Uesato et al. (2022, GSM8K) report that outcome-based supervision reached similar final-answer error rates with less labelling, while process-based supervision (or reward models that emulate it) was needed for correct reasoning steps; Lightman et al. (2023, MATH) report that process supervision significantly outperformed outcome supervision. Results depend on domain, model scale and labelling method and should not be assumed to transfer.
change_log.reason: Overgeneralised: Uesato et al. did not find a final-answer advantage for process supervision.
change_log.source: arXiv:2211.14275 and arXiv:2305.20050 abstracts (verified 2026-10-09)
